fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use MSHTA in Scripts
fields.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use MSHTA
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "set" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "&&" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "mshta" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "vbscript:createobject" and tgt.process.cmdline contains ".run" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "(window.close)"))
